messages:
Priya Rao: Hey team — NovaHealth POC kickoff this week, need to align success criteria, SE coverage, and security asks. Customer expects a 6-week evaluation, but procurement might push.
Marco Silva: Quick q — do they want hosted API or dedicated pool for the POC? This affects SE time and cost estimates.
Jamie Liu: Sales here — they asked for dedicated due to PHI concerns, but will accept hosted if we sign the DPA and show KMS controls. Procurement target: decision by 2024-12-15.
Olivia Chen: Copy. From infra side dedicated pool means 1x A40-type pod for baseline. I can reserve it but need confirmation of expected QPS and max sequence lengths.
Priya Rao: Success criteria proposed by customer: 1) 95% of clinical note rewrites match labeler rubric >=0.8, 2) end-to-end latency < 450ms median, 3) zero data exfiltration and audit logs enabled.
Daniel Park: For evals we should define prompt set + golden labels. Marco — can your team generate 200 annotated examples?
Marco Silva: Yes, we can do 200 in two sprints. Suggest split: 120 real prompts, 80 fuzz/edge cases.
Olivia Chen: For latency SLO we'll need KV prefix caching and batching config. Proposed runtime config snippet:
```
batching: auto
kv_cache: enabled
max_batch_size: 32
preferred_latency_target_ms: 350
```
Marco Silva: That config looks good. Need to test with simulated load ~10 rps to validate tail latency.
Jamie Liu: Pricing note — customer asked for an estimate for a 6-week POC on dedicated. Can we give a ballpark including 1x dedicated pod + SE support (20 hrs/wk)?
Priya Rao: Ballpark: dedicated pod $12k/wk + SE @ $250/hr => 20*6*250 = $30k. POC total ~ $102k (incl. some infra buffers). Need finance approval but shareable as estimate.
Daniel Park: Heads-up: security team flagged their infosec form — they want SOC2 cert, KMS flow diagram, and data retention policy. I can pull SOC2 doc and DPA link. Need someone to fill the questionnaire (about 10 short answers).
Priya Rao: I'll take the questionnaire with Jamie. Jamie, can you get the vendor security contact and timeline from NovaHealth?
Jamie Liu: Reached out, their security lead (zoe@nhealth.com) said they can return the questionnaire in 4 business days if we send initial answers. Procurement might require a PO by 2024-12-20.
SE-Bot: DeployBot: reserved dedicated pool template created (pool-id: pool-nova-01). Provisioning ETA 48h.
Olivia Chen: Provisioning note — we need to enable audit logs + KMS key binding. DM me the customer KMS alias once procurement done.
Marco Silva: Action items from SE: 1) build prompt/eval set (Marco) 2) run test harness at 10rps (Marco+Daniel) 3) provide sample inference scripts for NovaHealth (Marco)
Priya Rao: Action items from Product/Infra: 1) reserve pool & enable KV caching (Olivia) 2) provide SOC2 + DPA (Daniel)
Jamie Liu: I'll draft the statement of work and the POC scope doc. Tentative timeline: Week 0 (setup + security signoff), Week 1-2 (prompt refinement + small pilots), Week 3-5 (scale tests + user evals), Week 6 (final report + handoff).
Priya Rao: Can we commit to SE coverage 10-15 hrs/wk after week 1? Marco, is that doable?
Marco Silva: Yes — can do 15 hrs/wk after initial burst (first two weeks I'll block 30 hrs/week).
Daniel Park: One blocker: NovaHealth's network team may require private peering for dedicated pool. If they do, timeline shifts +2 weeks. Jamie, ask them about peering requirement ASAP.
Jamie Liu: Will confirm today. Also sharing sample contract clause that they often request for data residency.
Priya Rao: Nice. Let's aim to have the prompt set and security questionnaire sent by EOD tomorrow. Marco — can you upload the prompt CSV to the shared drive?
Marco Silva: Yep, will upload by EOD. :thumbsup:
Olivia Chen: I'll follow up on audit/KMS docs and post links here when available.
SE-Bot: Reminder: please include model family and max sequence length in provisioning form.
Priya Rao: Thanks all — I'll compile action items into a short POC kickoff email and hit the threads. Meeting to sync tomorrow 11am PT.
Daniel Park: +1.
Jamie Liu: Thanks, team.
Marco Silva: See you tomorrow.
Olivia Chen: Thanks!
